headline: Title premium growth and investment gains drive profit surge
summary_short: Revenue for the quarter ended June 30, 2026 rose 15.0% y/y to $2.12B and diluted EPS climbed 50.4% y/y to $2.12, as net income jumped 49.6% y/y to $218.5M on higher title premiums, escrow fees, and investment gains.
summary_long: Revenue rose 15.0% y/y to $2.12B, driven by a $103.2M (+14.4%) increase in agent premiums, an $88.8M (+14.8%) rise in direct premiums and escrow fees, and a swing to $12.0M of net investment gains from $9.7M of losses a year ago. Title insurance segment pretax margin improved to 15.7% from 12.6% on higher order volumes and a richer commercial/purchase mix; personnel costs rose 9.5% on higher incentive pay. Net income rose 49.6% y/y to $218.5M ($2.12 diluted EPS), aided by a lower 22.8% effective tax rate versus 24.6% a year ago. Cash rose to $2.62B; the company paid $0.55/share in dividends and repurchased $20.5M of stock this quarter. No forward guidance was given.
